sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Gobind Korla, Additional Advocate General, for the applicants/appellants.
Mr. Onkar Jairath, Advocate, for the respondent.
A perusal of the paper book would go on to show that the respondent as such was charged under Section 376 of IPC and also convicted for seven years on 04.01.2023.

In the Appeal preferred before this Court, the order/judgment of the Sessions Court was set aside on 15.06.2010, which is clear from the letter dated 12.03.2024 (Annexure A-1), whereby he has been reinstated as such.
Let the orders of the criminal Court be placed on record by the respondent before the next date of hearing.

(G.S. Sandhawalia) Chief Justice (Ranjan Sharma) Judge 3rd June, 2025 (munish thakur)
